label: Campaign
description: An Adnet advertising campaign — a CampaignContract on chain. No schema.org type fits, so this is an epistery-published vocabulary: the contract's declared state (budget, rates, settlement rule, promotions) projected for search, display, and trust factors. The chain state is re-readable by anyone; scan's copy is a cache of it.

trust.note: Reserved — campaign trust factors (funded budget, settlement history, advertiser identity binding) declared here as the market defines them. The contract itself is the primary fact: every figure is re-readable on chain.
